   451→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   452→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   453→// For Gemini CLI and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   454→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   455→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   456→	if content == "" {
   457→		return 0
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   461→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   462→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   463→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   464→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   465→		}
   466→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   467→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   468→			return 0
   469→		}
   470→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   471→	}
   472→
   473→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   474→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   475→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   476→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   477→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   478→	}
   479→	return len(allLines)
   480→}

   482→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   483→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   484→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   485→	if content == "" {
   486→		return nil
   487→	}
   488→
   489→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   490→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   491→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   492→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   493→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   494→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   495→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   496→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   497→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   498→				}
   499→			}
   500→			return cleaned
   501→		}
   502→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   503→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   504→			return nil
   505→		}
   506→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   507→	}
   508→
   509→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   510→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   511→}

   513→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   514→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   515→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   516→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   517→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   518→	if len(data) == 0 {
   519→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   520→	}
   521→
   522→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   523→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   524→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   525→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   526→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   527→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   528→		}
   529→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   530→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   531→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   532→		}
   533→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   537→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromBytes(data)
   538→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   539→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   540→	}
   541→	// Slice transcript lines to only include checkpoint portion
   542→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   543→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   544→	}
   545→	return claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(lines)
   546→}

   548→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   549→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   550→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   551→	var prompts []string
   552→	for _, line := range lines {
   553→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   554→		if line == "" {
   555→			continue
   556→		}
   557→
   558→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   559→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   560→			continue
   561→		}
   562→
   563→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   564→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   565→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   566→			continue
   567→		}
   568→
   569→		// Extract message content
   570→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   571→		if !ok {
   572→			continue
   573→		}
   574→
   575→		// Handle string content
   576→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   577→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   578→			if cleaned != "" {
   579→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   580→			}
   581→			continue
   582→		}
   583→
   584→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   585→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   586→			var texts []string
   587→			for _, item := range arr {
   588→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   589→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   590→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   591→							texts = append(texts, text)
   592→						}
   593→					}
   594→				}
   595→			}
   596→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   597→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   598→				if cleaned != "" {
   599→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   600→				}
   601→			}
   602→		}
   603→	}
   604→	return prompts
   605→}

   607→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   608→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   609→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   610→		return nil
   611→	}
   612→
   613→	var buf strings.Builder
   614→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   615→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   616→
   617→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   618→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   619→		displayPrompt := prompt
   620→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   621→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   622→		}

   624→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   625→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   626→	}
   627→
   628→	return []byte(buf.String())

   631→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   632→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   633→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   634→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   635→
   636→	// Load session state
   637→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   638→	if err != nil {
   639→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   640→	}
   641→	if state == nil {
   642→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   643→	}
   644→
   645→	// Open repository
   646→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   647→	if err != nil {
   648→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   649→	}
   650→
   651→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   652→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   653→	if err != nil {
   654→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   655→	}
   656→
   657→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   658→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   659→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   660→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   661→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   662→
   663→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   664→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   665→		// Just clean up the state file.
   666→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   667→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   668→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   669→		)
   670→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   671→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   672→		}
   673→		return nil
   674→	}
   675→
   676→	// Condense the session
   677→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   678→	if err != nil {
   679→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   680→	}
   681→
   682→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   683→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   684→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   685→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   686→	)
   687→
   688→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   689→	state.StepCount = 0
   690→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   691→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   692→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   693→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   694→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   695→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   696→
   697→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   698→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   699→	}
   700→
   701→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   702→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   703→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   704→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   705→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   706→		)
   707→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	return nil
   711→}

   713→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   714→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   715→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   716→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   717→	if err != nil {
   718→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	for _, state := range allStates {
   722→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   723→			continue
   724→		}
   725→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   726→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   727→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   728→			return nil
   729→		}
   730→	}
   731→
   732→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   733→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   734→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   735→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   736→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   737→			return nil
   738→		}
   739→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   740→	}
   741→	return nil
   742→}

    16→// TestShadowStrategy_MidSessionCommit_FromTranscript tests that when Claude commits
    17→// mid-session (before Stop has been called), the prepare-commit-msg hook detects
    18→// the new work by checking the live transcript and adds a checkpoint trailer.
    19→//
    20→// This is scenario 2 from ENT-112:
    21→// - User prompts Claude
    22→// - Claude creates files and commits them
    23→// - No Stop has happened yet (no shadow branch)
    24→// - The commit should still get a checkpoint trailer because the transcript shows file modifications
    25→func TestShadowStrategy_MidSessionCommit_FromTranscript(t *testing.T) {
    26→	t.Parallel()
    27→
    28→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    29→
    30→	session := env.NewSession()
    31→
    32→	// Simulate user prompt (initializes session with BaseCommit and TranscriptPath)
    33→	// We need to pass the transcript path so it gets stored in session state
    34→	input := map[string]string{
    35→		"session_id":      session.ID,
    36→		"transcript_path": session.TranscriptPath,
    37→	}
    38→	inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(input)
    39→	cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "claude-code", "user-prompt-submit")
    40→	cmd.Dir = env.RepoDir
    41→	cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
    42→	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
    43→		"ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="+env.ClaudeProjectDir,
    44→	)
    45→	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
    46→		t.Fatalf("user-prompt-submit failed: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	// Verify session state has transcript path
    50→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
    51→	if err != nil {
    52→		t.Fatalf("Failed to get session state: %v", err)
    53→	}
    54→	if state == nil {
    55→		t.Fatal("Session state is nil")
    56→	}
    57→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
    58→		t.Error("Session state should have TranscriptPath after user-prompt-submit")
    59→	}
    60→	t.Logf("Session state TranscriptPath: %s", state.TranscriptPath)
    61→
    62→	// Create a file as if Claude wrote it
    63→	env.WriteFile("claude_file.txt", "content from Claude")
    64→
    65→	// Create transcript showing Claude created the file (NO Stop called)
    66→	session.CreateTranscript("Create a file for me", []FileChange{
    67→		{Path: "claude_file.txt", Content: "content from Claude"},
    68→	})
    69→
    70→	// Verify NO shadow branch exists (Stop hasn't been called)
    71→	shadowBranches := env.ListBranchesWithPrefix("entire/")
    72→	hasShadowBranch := false
    73→	for _, b := range shadowBranches {
    74→		if b != paths.MetadataBranchName {
    75→			hasShadowBranch = true
    76→			break
    77→		}
    78→	}
    79→	if hasShadowBranch {
    80→		t.Error("Shadow branch should not exist before Stop is called")
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	// Get HEAD before commit
    84→	headBefore := env.GetHeadHash()
    85→
    86→	// Commit with shadow hooks - should add trailer because transcript shows file modifications
    87→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file from Claude (mid-session)", "claude_file.txt")
    88→
    89→	// Get the commit
    90→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
    91→	if commitHash == headBefore {
    92→		t.Fatal("Commit was not created")
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	// CRITICAL: Verify commit has a checkpoint trailer
    96→	// This is the fix for ENT-112 scenario 2: detect work from live transcript
    97→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commitHash)
    98→	if checkpointID == "" {
    99→		t.Error("Mid-session commit should have Entire-Checkpoint trailer when transcript shows file modifications")
   100→	} else {
   101→		t.Logf("Mid-session commit has checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID)
   102→	}
   103→}

   139→func TestShadowStrategy_MidSessionCommit_NoTrailerForUnrelatedFile(t *testing.T) {

   244→// CreateTranscript builds and writes a transcript for the session.
   245→func (s *Session) CreateTranscript(prompt string, changes []FileChange) string {
   246→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage(prompt)
   247→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll help you with that.")
   248→
   249→	for _, change := range changes {
   250→		toolID := s.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", change.Path, change.Content)
   251→		s.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID)
   252→	}
   253→
   254→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
   255→
   256→	if err := s.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(s.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   257→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   258→	}
   259→
   260→	return s.TranscriptPath
   261→}

   652→func (s *GeminiSession) CreateGeminiTranscript(prompt string, changes []FileChange) string {
   653→	// Build Gemini-format transcript (JSON, not JSONL)
   654→	messages := []map[string]interface{}{

   657→			"content": prompt,
   658→		},

   661→			"content": "I'll help you with that.",
   662→		},
   663→	}
   664→
   665→	for _, change := range changes {
   666→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   667→			"type": "tool_use",
   668→			"name": "write_file",
   669→			"input": map[string]string{
   670→				"path":    change.Path,
   671→				"content": change.Content,
   672→			},
   673→		})
   674→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   675→			"type":   "tool_result",
   676→			"output": "File written successfully",

   678→	}
   679→
   680→	messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   681→		"type":    "assistant",
   682→		"content": "Done!",
   683→	})
   684→
   685→	transcript := map[string]interface{}{

   690→	// Ensure directory exists

   701→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   702→	}
   703→
   704→	return s.TranscriptPath

   117→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   118→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   119→	)
   120→
   121→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   122→	if sessionID == "" {
   123→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   127→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   128→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   132→	// Without this, the function does a lot of work (transcript copy, prompt extraction, etc.)
   133→	// before eventually failing deep in strategy.SaveChanges().
   134→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   135→		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping checkpoint. Will activate after first commit.")
   136→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   140→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   141→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   142→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   143→	if err != nil {
   144→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   145→	}
   146→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   147→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   148→	}
   149→
   150→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   151→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   152→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   153→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   154→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   155→
   156→	// Copy transcript
   157→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   158→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   159→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   160→	}
   161→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   162→
   163→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   164→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   165→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   166→	if err != nil {
   167→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   171→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   172→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   173→	var transcriptOffset int
   174→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   175→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   176→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   177→	} else {
   178→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   179→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   180→		if loadErr != nil {
   181→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   182→		}
   183→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   184→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   185→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   186→		}
   187→	}
   188→
   189→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   190→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   191→	var transcriptLines []transcriptLine
   192→	var totalLines int
   193→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   194→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   195→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   196→		if err != nil {
   197→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   198→		}
   199→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcriptLines), totalLines)
   200→	} else {
   201→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   202→		// Use ParseFromFileAtLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   203→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   204→		if err != nil {
   205→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   206→		}
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   210→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcriptLines)
   211→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   212→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   213→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   214→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   215→	}
   216→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   217→
   218→	// Extract summary
   219→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   220→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcriptLines)
   221→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   222→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   223→	}
   224→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   225→
   226→	// Get modified files from transcript (main agent + subagents).
   227→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   228→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), input.SessionID, "subagents")
   229→	modifiedFiles, subagentErr := claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir)
   230→	if subagentErr != nil {
   231→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to extract modified files with subagents: %v\n", subagentErr)
   232→		// Fall back to main transcript only
   233→		modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcriptLines)
   234→	}
   235→
   236→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   237→	lastPrompt := ""
   238→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   239→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   240→	}
   241→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   242→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   243→
   244→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   245→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   246→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   247→	if err != nil {
   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	if preState != nil {
   252→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   253→	}
   254→
   255→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   256→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   257→	if err != nil {
   258→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   259→	}
   260→
   261→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   262→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   263→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   264→	if changes != nil {
   265→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   266→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   267→	}
   268→
   269→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   270→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   271→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   272→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   273→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   274→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   275→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   276→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   277→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   278→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   279→		}
   280→		return nil
   281→	}
   282→
   283→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   284→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   285→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   286→	}
   287→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   288→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   289→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   290→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   291→		}
   292→	}
   293→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   294→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   295→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   296→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   297→		}
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Create context file before saving changes
   301→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   302→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcriptLines); err != nil {
   303→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   304→	}
   305→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   306→
   307→	// Get git author from local/global config
   308→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   309→	if err != nil {
   310→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Get the configured strategy
   314→	strat := GetStrategy()
   315→
   316→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   317→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   318→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   319→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   323→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   324→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   325→	if preState != nil {
   326→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   327→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   331→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   332→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   333→		usage, tokenErr := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   334→		if tokenErr != nil {
   335→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", tokenErr)
   336→		} else {
   337→			tokenUsage = usage
   338→		}
   339→	}
   340→
   341→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   342→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   343→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   344→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   345→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   346→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   347→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   348→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   349→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   350→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   351→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   352→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   353→		AgentType:                agentType,
   354→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   355→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   356→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   357→	}
   358→
   359→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   360→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   361→	}
   362→
   363→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   364→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   365→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   366→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   367→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   368→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   369→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   370→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   371→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   372→		if loadErr != nil {
   373→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   374→		}
   375→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   376→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   377→		if sessionState == nil {
   378→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   379→				SessionID: sessionID,
   380→			}
   381→		}
   382→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   383→		sessionState.StepCount++
   384→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   385→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   386→		} else {
   387→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   388→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   389→		}
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   393→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE.
   394→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   395→
   396→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   397→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   398→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	return nil
   402→}

   404→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   405→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   406→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   407→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   408→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   409→	if err != nil {
   410→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   411→	}
   412→
   413→	// Get agent for logging context
   414→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   415→	if err != nil {
   416→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   417→	}
   418→
   419→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   420→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   421→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   422→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   423→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   424→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   425→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   426→	)
   427→
   428→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   429→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   430→	if !found {
   431→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   432→		return nil
   433→	}
   434→
   435→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   436→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   437→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   438→		return nil
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   442→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   443→	if err != nil {
   444→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   445→		return nil
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   449→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   450→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   451→		return nil
   452→	}
   453→
   454→	// Get git author
   455→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   456→	if err != nil {
   457→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   458→		return nil
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Get the active strategy
   462→	strat := GetStrategy()
   463→
   464→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   465→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   466→	if sessionID == "" {
   467→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   468→	}
   469→
   470→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   471→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   472→
   473→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   474→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   475→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   476→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   477→	if todoContent == "" {
   478→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   479→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   480→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   481→		if todoCount > 0 {
   482→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   483→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   484→		}
   485→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   486→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   487→	}
   488→
   489→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   490→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   491→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   492→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   493→	}
   494→
   495→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   496→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   497→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   498→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   499→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   500→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   501→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   502→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   503→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   504→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   505→		IsIncremental:       true,
   506→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   507→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   508→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   509→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   510→		AgentType:           agentType,
   511→	}
   512→
   513→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   514→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   515→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   516→		return nil
   517→	}
   518→
   519→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   520→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   521→	return nil
   522→}

   560→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   561→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   562→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   563→	if err != nil {
   564→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   565→	}
   566→
   567→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   568→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   569→
   570→	// Get agent for logging context
   571→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   572→	if err != nil {
   573→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   574→	}
   575→
   576→	// Log parsed input context
   577→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   578→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   579→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   580→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   581→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   582→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   583→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   584→	)
   585→
   586→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   587→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   588→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   589→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   590→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   591→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   592→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   593→		}
   594→	}
   595→
   596→	// Log context to stdout
   597→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   598→
   599→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   600→	var modifiedFiles []string
   601→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   602→		// Use subagent transcript if available
   603→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(subagentTranscriptPath, 0)
   604→		if parseErr != nil {
   605→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse subagent transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   606→		} else {
   607→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   608→		}
   609→	} else {
   610→		// Fall back to main transcript
   611→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(input.TranscriptPath, 0)
   612→		if parseErr != nil {
   613→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   614→		} else {
   615→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   616→		}
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// Load pre-task state and compute new files

   887→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   888→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   889→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   890→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   891→
   892→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   893→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   894→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   895→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   896→//
   897→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   898→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   899→//
   900→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   901→// with whatever data is available.
   902→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   903→	const (
   904→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   905→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   906→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   907→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   908→	)
   909→
   910→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   911→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   912→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   913→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   914→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   915→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   916→			)
   917→			return
   918→		}
   919→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   920→	}
   921→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   922→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   923→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   924→	)
   925→}

   927→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   928→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   929→// close to hookStartTime.
   930→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   931→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   932→	if err != nil {
   933→		return false
   934→	}
   935→	defer f.Close()
   936→
   937→	// Seek to tail
   938→	info, err := f.Stat()
   939→	if err != nil {
   940→		return false
   941→	}
   942→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   943→	if offset < 0 {
   944→		offset = 0
   945→	}
   946→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   947→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   948→		return false
   949→	}
   950→
   951→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
   952→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
   953→	for _, line := range lines {
   954→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   955→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
   956→			continue
   957→		}
   958→
   959→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
   960→		var entry struct {
   961→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
   962→		}
   963→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
   964→			continue
   965→		}
   966→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
   967→		if err != nil {
   968→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
   969→			if err != nil {
   970→				continue
   971→			}
   972→		}
   973→
   974→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
   975→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
   976→			return true
   977→		}
   978→	}
   979→	return false
   980→}

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

Claiming work is complete without verification is dishonesty, not efficiency.

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
❌ Trust agent report
```

## Why This Matters

From 24 failure memories:
- your human partner said "I don't believe you" - trust broken
- Undefined functions shipped - would crash
- Missing requirements shipped - incomplete features
- Time wasted on false completion → redirect → rework
- Violates: "Honesty is a core value. If you lie, you'll be replaced."

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness

## The Bottom Line

**No shortcuts for verification.**

Run the command. Read the output. THEN claim the result.

This is non-negotiable.

# Finishing a Development Branch

## Overview

Guide completion of development work by presenting clear options and handling chosen workflow.

**Core principle:** Verify tests → Present options → Execute choice → Clean up.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work."

## The Process

### Step 1: Verify Tests

**Before presenting options, verify tests pass:**

```bash
# Run project's test suite
npm test / cargo test / pytest / go test ./...
```

**If tests fail:**
```
Tests failing (<N> failures). Must fix before completing:

[Show failures]

Cannot proceed with merge/PR until tests pass.
```

Stop. Don't proceed to Step 2.

**If tests pass:** Continue to Step 2.

### Step 2: Determine Base Branch

```bash
# Try common base branches
git merge-base HEAD main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD master 2>/dev/null
```

Or ask: "This branch split from main - is that correct?"

### Step 3: Present Options

Present exactly these 4 options:

```
Implementation complete. What would you like to do?

1. Merge back to <base-branch> locally
2. Push and create a Pull Request
3. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later)
4. Discard this work

Which option?
```

**Don't add explanation** - keep options concise.

### Step 4: Execute Choice

#### Option 1: Merge Locally

```bash
# Switch to base branch
git checkout <base-branch>

# Pull latest
git pull

# Merge feature branch
git merge <feature-branch>

# Verify tests on merged result
<test command>

# If tests pass
git branch -d <feature-branch>
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

#### Option 2: Push and Create PR

```bash
# Push branch
git push -u origin <feature-branch>

# Create PR
gh pr create --title "<title>" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
<2-3 bullets of what changed>

## Test Plan
- [ ] <verification steps>
EOF
)"
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

#### Option 3: Keep As-Is

Report: "Keeping branch <name>. Worktree preserved at <path>."

**Don't cleanup worktree.**

#### Option 4: Discard

**Confirm first:**
```
This will permanently delete:
- Branch <name>
- All commits: <commit-list>
- Worktree at <path>

Type 'discard' to confirm.
```

Wait for exact confirmation.

If confirmed:
```bash
git checkout <base-branch>
git branch -D <feature-branch>
```

Then: Cleanup worktree (Step 5)

### Step 5: Cleanup Worktree

**For Options 1, 2, 4:**


If yes:
```bash
git worktree remove <worktree-path>
```

**For Option 3:** Keep worktree.

| Option | Merge | Push | Keep Worktree | Cleanup Branch |
|--------|-------|------|---------------|----------------|
| 1. Merge locally | ✓ | - | - | ✓ |
| 2. Create PR | - | ✓ | ✓ | - |
| 3. Keep as-is | - | - | ✓ | - |
| 4. Discard | - | - | - | ✓ (force) |

**Skipping test verification**
- **Problem:** Merge broken code, create failing PR
- **Fix:** Always verify tests before offering options

**Open-ended questions**
- **Problem:** "What should I do next?" → ambiguous

## Hook Handler Architecture Changes: origin/main vs. Current Branch

### ARCHITECTURE ON origin/main

**Key Characteristic:** Lifecycle-driven, agent-defined interface approach

**Core Components:**

1. **HookSupport Interface** (`cmd/entire/cli/agent/agent.go`):
   ```go
   type HookSupport interface {
       Agent
       HookNames() []string  // Agent declares what hooks it supports
       ParseHookEvent(ctx context.Context, hookName string, stdin io.Reader) (*Event, error)
       InstallHooks(ctx context.Context, localDev bool, force bool) (int, error)
       UninstallHooks(ctx context.Context) error
       AreHooksInstalled(ctx context.Context) bool
   }
   ```

2. **Hook Registry** (`cmd/entire/cli/hook_registry.go`):
   - **No persistent registry** - handlers are NOT registered in `init()`
   - Handler dispatch uses `ParseHookEvent()` to translate native hooks to normalized `*Event` objects
   - **Single dispatch path:** `DispatchLifecycleEvent()` handles all lifecycle events
   - Exception: `PostTodo` handled separately via `handleClaudeCodePostTodo()` (Claude-specific)

3. **Hook Processing Flow:**
   - Parse hook input → translate to lifecycle Event → dispatch to generic handler
   - Handlers are defined INSIDE agents (not in CLI package)
   - CLI doesn't know handler implementation details

4. **Files:**
   - `hooks.go` - Input parsing helpers + shared hook types (TaskHookInput, PostTaskHookInput, SubagentCheckpointHookInput)
   - `hooks_cmd.go` - Simple command structure, no handler registration
   - `hooks_claudecode_posttodo.go` - Single Claude-specific handler (post-todo only)
   - `hook_registry.go` - Registry infra + command builders (no handler registration)

---

### ARCHITECTURE ON CURRENT BRANCH (alex/add-edit-tool-hooks)

**Key Characteristic:** Handler registry pattern, CLI-defined implementations

**Core Components:**

1. **HookHandler Interface** (`cmd/entire/cli/agent/agent.go`):
   ```go
   type HookHandler interface {
       Agent
       GetHookNames() []string  // Agent declares what hooks it supports
   }
   ```
   Much simpler! No hook event parsing, no lifecycle event translation.

2. **Hook Registry** (`cmd/entire/cli/hook_registry.go`):
   ```go
   type HookHandlerFunc func() error
   var hookRegistry = map[agent.AgentName]map[string]HookHandlerFunc{}
   
   func RegisterHookHandler(agentName agent.AgentName, hookName string, handler HookHandlerFunc)
   ```
   - **Persistent registry** - handlers registered in `init()` function
   - Handlers are **simple closures** that take no args, return error
   - Handler retrieval: `GetHookHandler(agentName, hookName)` → `HookHandlerFunc`
   - Direct dispatch: `handler()` with no event translation

3. **Hook Processing Flow:**
   - No event translation/parsing at hook command level
   - Handler reads from `os.Stdin` directly
   - Handler does its own input parsing (tool-specific)
   - Direct function call to registered handler

4. **Files:**
   - `hooks.go` - Input parsing helpers + shared hook types
   - `hooks_cmd.go` - Simple command builder (2 lines per agent)
   - `hooks_claudecode_handlers.go` - All Claude handlers (session-start, session-end, stop, user-prompt-submit, pre-task, post-task, post-todo, **post-file-edit**)
   - `hooks_geminicli_handlers.go` - All Gemini handlers
   - `hooks_file_edit.go` - Parsing logic for file edit hooks
   - `hook_registry.go` - Registry pattern + command builders + handler registration

---

### KEY DIFFERENCES

| Aspect | origin/main | Current Branch |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| **Handler Storage** | Agent implementations | CLI package registry |
| **Hook Verification** | ParseHookEvent → *Event | GetHookHandler lookup |
| **Event Translation** | Agents translate to Events | No translation (direct parsing) |

| **Dispatch Logic** | DispatchLifecycleEvent generic | GetHookHandler lookup |
| **Handler Complexity** | Lower (agents define logic) | Higher (CLI defines logic) |
| **File Edits** | Not supported | Supported (post-file-edit hook) |
| **Post-Todo** | Special case handler | Registered handler in registry |

   ```go
   }
   ```

    48→// worktreeRootCache caches the worktree root to avoid repeated git commands.

    56→// WorktreeRoot returns the git worktree root directory.
    57→// Uses 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' which returns the working tree toplevel.
    58→// In a worktree this is the worktree root, not the main repository root.
    59→// The result is cached per working directory.
    60→// Returns an error if not inside a git repository.
    61→func WorktreeRoot(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
    62→	// Get current working directory to check cache validity
    63→	cwd, err := os.Getwd() //nolint:forbidigo // already present in codebase
    64→	if err != nil {
    65→		cwd = ""
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	// Check cache with read lock first
    69→	worktreeRootMu.RLock()
    70→	if worktreeRootCache != "" && worktreeRootCacheDir == cwd {
    71→		cached := worktreeRootCache
    72→		worktreeRootMu.RUnlock()
    73→		return cached, nil
    74→	}
    75→	worktreeRootMu.RUnlock()
    76→
    77→	// Cache miss - get worktree root and update cache with write lock

    79→	output, err := cmd.Output()

    82→	}

    84→	root := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
    85→

    87→	worktreeRootCache = root
    88→	worktreeRootCacheDir = cwd
    89→	worktreeRootMu.Unlock()

    91→	return root, nil

   181→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.

   183→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad(ctx context.Context) {
   184→	// Normalize legacy phase values. "active_committed" was removed with the
   185→	// 1:1 checkpoint model in favor of the state machine handling commits
   186→	// during ACTIVE phase with immediate condensation.
   187→	if s.Phase == "active_committed" {
   188→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "session")
   189→		logging.Info(logCtx, "migrating legacy active_committed phase to active",
   190→			slog.String("session_id", s.SessionID),
   191→		)
   192→		s.Phase = PhaseActive
   193→	}
   194→	// Also normalize via PhaseFromString to handle any other legacy/unknown values.
   195→	s.Phase = PhaseFromString(string(s.Phase))
   196→
   197→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   198→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   199→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   200→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   201→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   202→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {

   208→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   209→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   210→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   211→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   212→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0

   215→	// Without this, a mid-turn commit would migrate BaseCommit and the fallback in
   216→	// calculateSessionAttributions would use the migrated value, producing zero attribution.
   217→	if s.AttributionBaseCommit == "" && s.BaseCommit != "" {
   218→		s.AttributionBaseCommit = s.BaseCommit

   272→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   273→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   274→	}
   275→	if err != nil {
   276→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	var state State
   280→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   281→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   282→	}
   283→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad(ctx)
   284→
   285→	if state.IsStale() {
   286→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "session")
   287→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "deleting stale session state",
   288→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   289→		)
   290→		_ = s.Clear(ctx, sessionID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup of stale session
   291→		return nil, nil             //nolint:nilnil // stale session treated as not found
   292→	}
   293→
   294→	return &state, nil
   295→}
   296→
   297→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   298→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   299→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   300→
   301→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   302→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   303→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   307→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   311→	if err != nil {
   312→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   313→	}
   314→
   315→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   316→
   317→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   318→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   319→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   320→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   321→	}
   322→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   323→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   324→	}
   325→	return nil
   326→}
   327→
   328→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   329→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   330→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   331→
   332→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   333→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   334→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   338→
   339→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   340→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   341→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   342→		}
   343→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   344→	}
   345→	return nil
   346→}
   347→
   348→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   349→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   350→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   351→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   352→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   353→	}
   354→	return nil
   355→}
   356→
   357→// List returns all session states.
   358→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   359→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   360→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   361→		return nil, nil
   362→	}
   363→	if err != nil {
   364→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   365→	}
   366→
   367→	var states []*State
   368→	for _, entry := range entries {
   369→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   370→			continue
   371→		}
   372→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   373→			continue // Skip temp files
   374→		}
   375→
   376→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   377→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   378→		if err != nil {
   379→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   380→		}
   381→		if state == nil {
   382→			continue // Not found or stale (Load handles cleanup)
   383→		}
   384→
   385→		states = append(states, state)
   386→	}
   387→	return states, nil
   388→}
   389→
   390→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   391→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   392→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   393→}

   395→// gitCommonDirCache caches the git common dir to avoid repeated subprocess calls.
   396→// Keyed by working directory to handle directory changes (same pattern as paths.WorktreeRoot).
   397→var (
   398→	gitCommonDirMu       sync.RWMutex
   399→	gitCommonDirCache    string
   400→	gitCommonDirCacheDir string
   401→)
   402→
   403→// ClearGitCommonDirCache clears the cached git common dir.
   404→// Useful for testing when changing directories.
   405→func ClearGitCommonDirCache() {
   406→	gitCommonDirMu.Lock()
   407→	gitCommonDirCache = ""
   408→	gitCommonDirCacheDir = ""
   409→	gitCommonDirMu.Unlock()
   410→}
   411→
   412→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   413→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   414→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   415→// The result is cached per working directory.
   416→func getGitCommonDir(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
   417→	cwd, err := os.Getwd() //nolint:forbidigo // used for cache key, not git-relative paths
   418→	if err != nil {
   419→		cwd = ""
   420→	}
   421→
   422→	// Check cache with read lock first
   423→	gitCommonDirMu.RLock()
   424→	if gitCommonDirCache != "" && gitCommonDirCacheDir == cwd {
   425→		cached := gitCommonDirCache
   426→		gitCommonDirMu.RUnlock()
   427→		return cached, nil
   428→	}
   429→	gitCommonDirMu.RUnlock()
   430→
   431→	// Cache miss — resolve via git subprocess
   432→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   433→	cmd.Dir = "."
   434→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   435→	if err != nil {
   436→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   437→	}
   438→
   439→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   440→
   441→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   442→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   443→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   444→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   445→	}
   446→	commonDir = filepath.Clean(commonDir)
   447→
   448→	gitCommonDirMu.Lock()
   449→	gitCommonDirCache = commonDir
   450→	gitCommonDirCacheDir = cwd
   451→	gitCommonDirMu.Unlock()
   452→
   453→	return commonDir, nil
   454→}

    23→// agentHookLogCleanup stores the cleanup function for agent hook logging.
    24→// Set by PersistentPreRunE, called by PersistentPostRunE.
    25→var agentHookLogCleanup func()
    26→
    27→// currentHookAgentName stores the agent name for the currently executing hook.
    28→// Set by newAgentHookVerbCmdWithLogging before calling the handler.
    29→// This allows handlers to know which agent invoked the hook without guessing.
    30→var currentHookAgentName types.AgentName
    31→
    32→// GetCurrentHookAgent returns the agent for the currently executing hook.
    33→// Returns the agent based on the hook command structure (e.g., "entire hooks claude-code ...")
    34→// rather than guessing from directory presence.
    35→// Falls back to GetAgent() if not in a hook context.
    36→func GetCurrentHookAgent() (agent.Agent, error) {
    37→	if currentHookAgentName == "" {
    38→		return nil, errors.New("not in a hook context: agent name not set")
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	ag, err := agent.Get(currentHookAgentName)
    42→	if err != nil {
    43→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("getting hook agent %q: %w", currentHookAgentName, err)
    44→	}
    45→	return ag, nil
    46→}
    47→
    48→// newAgentHooksCmd creates a hooks subcommand for an agent that implements HookSupport.
    49→// It dynamically creates subcommands for each hook the agent supports.
    50→func newAgentHooksCmd(agentName types.AgentName, handler agent.HookSupport) *cobra.Command {
    51→	cmd := &cobra.Command{
    52→		Use:    string(agentName),
    53→		Short:  handler.Description() + " hook handlers",
    54→		Hidden: true,
    55→		PersistentPreRunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
    56→			agentHookLogCleanup = initHookLogging(cmd.Context())
    57→			return nil
    58→		},
    59→		PersistentPostRunE: func(_ *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
    60→			if agentHookLogCleanup != nil {
    61→				agentHookLogCleanup()
    62→			}
    63→			return nil
    64→		},
    65→	}
    66→
    67→	for _, hookName := range handler.HookNames() {
    68→		cmd.AddCommand(newAgentHookVerbCmdWithLogging(agentName, hookName))
    69→	}
    70→
    71→	return cmd
    72→}
    73→
    74→// getHookType returns the hook type based on the hook name.
    75→// Returns "subagent" for task-related hooks (pre-task, post-task, post-todo),
    76→// "tool" for tool-related hooks (before-tool, after-tool),
    77→// "agent" for all other agent hooks.
    78→func getHookType(hookName string) string {
    79→	switch hookName {
    80→	case claudecode.HookNamePreTask, claudecode.HookNamePostTask, claudecode.HookNamePostTodo:
    81→		return "subagent"
    82→	case geminicli.HookNameBeforeTool, geminicli.HookNameAfterTool:
    83→		return "tool"
    84→	default:
    85→		return "agent"
    86→	}
    87→}
    88→
    89→// newAgentHookVerbCmdWithLogging creates a command for a specific hook verb with structured logging.
    90→// It uses the lifecycle dispatcher (ParseHookEvent → DispatchLifecycleEvent) as the primary path.
    91→// PostTodo is handled directly as it's Claude-specific and not part of the lifecycle dispatcher.
    92→func newAgentHookVerbCmdWithLogging(agentName types.AgentName, hookName string) *cobra.Command {
    93→	return &cobra.Command{
    94→		Use:    hookName,
    95→		Hidden: true,
    96→		Short:  "Called on " + hookName,
    97→		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
    98→			// Skip silently if not in a git repository - hooks shouldn't prevent the agent from working
    99→			if _, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(cmd.Context()); err != nil {
   100→				return nil
   101→			}
   102→
   103→			// Skip if Entire is not enabled
   104→			enabled, err := IsEnabled(cmd.Context())
   105→			if err == nil && !enabled {
   106→				return nil
   107→			}
   108→
   109→			start := time.Now()
   110→
   111→			// Initialize logging context with agent name
   112→			ctx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(cmd.Context(), "hooks"), agentName)
   113→
   114→			// Strategy name for logging
   115→			strategyName := strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit
   116→
   117→			hookType := getHookType(hookName)
   118→
   119→			logging.Debug(ctx, "hook invoked",
   120→				slog.String("hook", hookName),
   121→				slog.String("hook_type", hookType),
   122→				slog.String("strategy", strategyName),
   123→			)
   124→
   125→			// Set the current hook agent so handlers can retrieve it
   126→			currentHookAgentName = agentName
   127→			defer func() { currentHookAgentName = "" }()
   128→
   129→			// Use the lifecycle dispatcher for all hooks
   130→			var hookErr error
   131→			ag, agentErr := agent.Get(agentName)
   132→			if agentErr != nil {
   133→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent %q: %w", agentName, agentErr)
   134→			}
   135→
   136→			handler, ok := ag.(agent.HookSupport)
   137→			if !ok {
   138→				return fmt.Errorf("agent %q does not support hooks", agentName)
   139→			}
   140→
   141→			// Use cmd.InOrStdin() to support testing with cmd.SetIn()
   142→			event, parseErr := handler.ParseHookEvent(ctx, hookName, cmd.InOrStdin())
   143→			if parseErr != nil {
   144→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook event: %w", parseErr)
   145→			}
   146→
   147→			if event != nil {
   148→				// Lifecycle event — use the generic dispatcher
   149→				hookErr = DispatchLifecycleEvent(ctx, ag, event)
   150→			} else if agentName == agent.AgentNameClaudeCode && hookName == claudecode.HookNamePostTodo {
   151→				// PostTodo is Claude-specific: creates incremental checkpoints during subagent execution
   152→				hookErr = handleClaudeCodePostTodo(ctx)
   153→			}
   154→			// Other pass-through hooks (nil event, no special handling) are no-ops
   155→
   156→			logging.LogDuration(ctx, slog.LevelDebug, "hook completed", start,
   157→				slog.String("hook", hookName),
   158→				slog.String("hook_type", hookType),
   159→				slog.String("strategy", strategyName),
   160→				slog.Bool("success", hookErr == nil),
   161→			)
   162→
   163→			return hookErr
   164→		},
   165→	}
   166→}

     2→// This is a Claude-specific hook that creates incremental checkpoints during subagent execution.
     3→// It's not part of the generic lifecycle dispatcher because it requires special handling:

     7→package cli
     8→
     9→import (

    11→	"fmt"
    12→	"io"
    13→	"log/slog"
    14→	"os"

    22→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
    23→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
    24→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
    25→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo(ctx context.Context) error {
    26→	return handleClaudeCodePostTodoFromReader(ctx, os.Stdin)
    27→}
    28→
    29→// handleClaudeCodePostTodoFromReader is the testable version that accepts an io.Reader.
    30→func handleClaudeCodePostTodoFromReader(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader) error {
    31→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(reader)
    32→	if err != nil {
    33→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	// Get agent for logging context
    37→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
    38→	if err != nil {
    39→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
    40→	}
    41→
    42→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "hooks"), ag.Name())
    43→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
    44→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
    45→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
    46→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
    47→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
    48→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
    49→	)
    50→
    51→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
    52→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile(ctx)
    53→	if !found {
    54→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
    55→		return nil
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
    59→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(ctx); skip {
    60→		logging.Info(logCtx, "skipping incremental checkpoint on default branch",
    61→			slog.String("branch", branchName))
    62→		return nil
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
    66→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, nil)
    67→	if err != nil {
    68→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to detect changed files",
    69→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
    70→		return nil
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
    74→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
    75→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint")
    76→		return nil
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	// Get git author
    80→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
    81→	if err != nil {
    82→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to get git author",
    83→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
    84→		return nil
    85→	}
    86→
    87→	// Get the active strategy
    88→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
    89→
    90→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
    91→	sessionID := input.SessionID
    92→	if sessionID == "" {
    93→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
    97→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
    98→
    99→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   100→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   101→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   102→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)

   105→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   106→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   107→		if todoCount > 0 {
   108→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   109→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   110→		}
   111→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   112→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   113→	}

   116→	var agentType types.AgentType
   117→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   118→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   119→	}
   120→
   121→	// Build incremental task step context
   122→	taskStepCtx := strategy.TaskStepContext{
   123→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   124→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   125→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   126→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   127→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   128→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   129→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   130→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   131→		IsIncremental:       true,
   132→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   133→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   134→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   135→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   136→		AgentType:           agentType,
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// Save incremental task step
   140→	if err := strat.SaveTaskStep(ctx, taskStepCtx); err != nil {
   141→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save incremental task step",
   142→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   143→		return nil
   144→	}
   145→
   146→	logging.Info(logCtx, "created incremental checkpoint",
   147→		slog.Int("sequence", seq),
   148→		slog.String("tool_name", input.ToolName),
   149→		slog.String("task", taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))]))
   150→	return nil
   151→}
